Calculation of mSAR from Mobile Phone Data

mpd_msar.Rd

Calculates mSAR (momentary specifc absorption rate) from data (mobile data and WiFi) use for a specific tissue

Usage

mpd_msar(
  tissue,
  duration_low,
  duration_lowmed,
  duration_medhigh,
  duration_high,
  use_5g,
  wifi_prop_home,
  wifi_prop_work,
  wifi_prop_travel,
  urbanicity,
  travel_time,
  params = load_params()
)

Arguments

tissue

Tissue for which to calculate mSAR (default: "brain" or "body")

duration_low

Duration (in seconds per day) of low output power activities

duration_lowmed

Duration (in seconds per day) of low-medium output power activities

duration_medhigh

Duration (in seconds per day) of medium-high output power activities

duration_high

Duration (in seconds per day) of high output power activities

use_5g

TRUE if 5G services are used for data transfer, FALSE if not

wifi_prop_home

Proportion of time connected to WiFi (vs mobile data) at home

wifi_prop_work

Proportion of time connected to WiFi (vs mobile data) at school / work

wifi_prop_travel

Proportion of time connected to WiFi (vs mobile data) while commuting

urbanicity

Urbanicity of home / workplace (rural, suburban, or urban)

travel_time

Time spent commuting in seconds per day

params

Parameter list (optional). If not specified, calculations use default parameters.

Value

Momentary SAR (mSAR) from mobile data use in mW/kg

Details

The mSAR is calculated as

$$mSAR = (1 - p_{wifi}) \times mSAR_{data} + p_{wifi} \times mSAR_{wifi}$$

with, for each network \(n\) (mobile data or WiFi),

$$mSAR_{n} = \sum_{b} s_{n,b} \times nSAR_{n,b} \times P_{n,b}$$

where

  • \(p_{wifi} = t_{home} w_{home} + t_{work} w_{work} + t_{travel} w_{travel}\) is the proportion of use over WiFi, with \(t\) the shares of the day at home, at work and commuting (see location_props()) and \(w\) the WiFi proportions (wifi_prop_home, wifi_prop_work, wifi_prop_travel); no WiFi is used outdoors

  • \(s_{n,b}\) is the share of the frequency band \(b\): 3G to 5G for mobile data (without 5G if use_5g is FALSE), 2.4 and 5 GHz for WiFi

  • \(nSAR_{n,b}\) is the normalized SAR in W/kg/W (see mpd_sar_data(), mpd_sar_wifi())

  • \(P_{n,b}\) is the mean output power of the phone in mW, including the duty cycles of the activities (see mpd_pwr_data(), mpd_pwr_wifi())

See also

mpd_pwr_data(), mpd_pwr_wifi(), mpd_sar_data(), mpd_sar_wifi()

Examples

mpd_msar(
tissue           = "brain",
duration_low     = 4860,
duration_lowmed  = 540,
duration_medhigh = 4860,
duration_high    = 540,
use_5g           = FALSE,
wifi_prop_home   = 0.5,
wifi_prop_work   = 0.5,
wifi_prop_travel = 0.5,
urbanicity       = "suburban",
travel_time      = 1800)
#> [1] 0.02215706
